ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ
en: (1) Alif, Lām, Meem.[1124]
tr: Alif lām mīm

ar: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
en: (2) Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?
tr: Aḥasiban-nāsu ay yutrakū ay yaqūlū āmannā wahum lā yuftanūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
en: (3) But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allāh will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.
tr: Walaqad fatannal-ladhīna min qablihim falayaʿlamannallāhul-ladhīna ṣadaqū walayaʿlamannal-kādhibīn

ar: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
en: (4) Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun [i.e., escape] Us? Evil is what they judge.
tr: Am ḥasibal-ladhīna yaʿmalūnas-sayyiʾāti ay yasbiqūnā, sāʾa mā yaḥkumūn

ar: مَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَـَٔاتٍ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (5) Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allāh - indeed, the term [decreed by] Allāh is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Man kāna yarjū liqāʾallāhi faʾinna ajalallāhi laʾāt, wahuwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: وَمَن جَٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَٰهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (6) And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allāh is Free from need of the worlds.
tr: Waman jāhada faʾinnamā yujāhidu linafsih, innallāha laghaniyyun ʿanil-ʿālamīn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (7) And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyiʾātihim walanajziyannahum aḥsanal-ladhī kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَآ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (8) And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge,[1125] do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
enNotes: [1125]- i.e., no knowledge of its divinity. There can be no knowledge about something which is non-existent or untrue.
tr: Wawaṣṣaynal-insāna biwālidayhi ḥusnā, waʾin jāhadāka litushrika bī mā laysa laka bihī ʿilmun falā tuṭiʿhumā, ilayya marjiʿukum faʾunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
en: (9) And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanudkhilannahum fiṣ-ṣāliḥīn

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (10) And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allāh, he considers the trial [i.e., harm] of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allāh. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allāh most knowing of what is within the breasts of the worlds [i.e., all creatures]?
tr: Waminan-nāsi may yaqūlu āmannā billāhi faʾidhā ūdhiya fillāhi jaʿala fitnatan-nāsi kaʿadhābillāh, walaʾin jāʾa naṣrum mir rabbika layaqūlunna innā kunnā maʿakum, awalaysallāhu biʾaʿlama bimā fī ṣudūril-ʿālamīn

ar: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ
en: (11) And Allāh will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.
tr: Walayaʿlamannallāhul-ladhīna āmanū walayaʿlamannal-munāfiqīn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
en: (12) And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins."[1126] But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars.
enNotes: [1126]- The phrase may also read: "and let us carry your sins," i.e., the responsibility for your sins.
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanuttabiʿū sabīlanā walnaḥmil khaṭāyākum, wamā hum biḥāmilīna min khaṭāyāhum min shayʾ, innahum lakādhibūn

ar: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
en: (13) But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens,[1127] and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.
enNotes: [1127]- Besides their own sins, they will carry those of the people they misled, although it will not lessen the burden of the latter.
tr: Walayaḥmilunna athqālahum waʾathqālam maʿa athqālihim walayusʾalunna yawmal-qiyāmati ʿammā kānū yaftarūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ
en: (14) And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.
tr: Walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihī falabitha fīhim alfa sanatin illā khamsīna ʿāmā, faʾakhadhahumuṭ-ṭūfānu wahum ẓālimūn

ar: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (15) But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it[1128] a sign for the worlds.
enNotes: [1128]- i.e., the ship, the event or the story.
tr: Faʾanjaynāhu waʾaṣḥābas-safīnati wajaʿalnāhā āyatal lil-ʿālamīn

ar: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (16) And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allāh and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.
tr: Waʾibrāhīma idh qāla liqawmihiʿbudullāha wattaqūh, dhālikum khayrul lakum in kuntum taʿlamūn

ar: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَٱبْتَغُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (17) You only worship, besides Allāh, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allāh do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allāh provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."
tr: Innamā taʿbudūna min dūnillāhi awthānaw watakhluqūna ifkā, innal-ladhīna taʿbudūna min dūnillāhi lā yamlikūna lakum rizqan fabtaghū ʿindallāhir-rizqa waʿbudūhu washkurū lah, ilayhi turjaʿūn

ar: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا۟ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: (18) And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.[1129]
enNotes: [1129]- Commentators have differed over this verse - whether it is a continuation of the words of Prophet Abraham or words of comfort given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ), which according to context seems more likely.
tr: Waʾin tukadhdhibū faqad kadhdhaba umamum min qablikum, wamā ʿalar-rasūli illal-balāghul-mubīn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
en: (19) Have they not considered how Allāh begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
tr: Awalam yaraw kayfa yubdiʾullāhul-khalqa thumma yuʿīduh, inna dhālika ʿalallāhi yasīr

ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (20) Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allāh will produce the final creation [i.e., development]. Indeed Allāh, over all things, is competent."
tr: Qul sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kayfa badaʾal-khalqa thummallāhu yunshiʾun-nashʾatal-ākhirah, innallāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ
en: (21) He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.
tr: Yuʿadhdhibu may yashāʾu wayarḥamu may yashāʾ, waʾilayhi tuqlabūn

ar: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
en: (22) And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allāh any protector or any helper.
tr: Wamā antum bimuʿjizīna fil-arḍi walā fis-samāʾ, wamā lakum min dūnillāhi miw waliyyiw walā naṣīr

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (23) And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.
tr: Wal-ladhīna kafarū biʾāyātillāhi waliqāʾihī ulāʾika yaʾisū mir raḥmatī waʾulāʾika lahum ʿadhābun alīm

ar: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (24) And the answer of his [i.e., Abraham's] people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allāh saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Famā kāna jawāba qawmihī illā an qāluqtulūhu aw ḥarriqūhu faʾanjāhullāhu minan-nār, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil liqawmiy yuʾminūn

ar: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَٰنًا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
en: (25) And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allāh, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."
tr: Waqāla innamattakhadhtum min dūnillāhi awthānam mawaddata baynikum fil-ḥayātid-dunyā, thumma yawmal-qiyāmati yakfuru baʿḍukum bibaʿḍiw wayalʿanu baʿḍukum baʿḍā, wamaʾwākumun-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīn

ar: فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٌ وَقَالَ إِنِّى مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (26) And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
tr: Faʾāmana lahū lūṭ, waqāla innī muhājirun ilā rabbī, innahū huwal-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَجْرَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
en: (27) And We gave to him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.
tr: Wawahabnā lahū isḥāqa wayaʿqūba wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihin-nubuwwata wal-kitāba waʾātaynāhu ajrahū fid-dunyā, waʾinnahū fil-ākhirati laminaṣ-ṣāliḥīn

ar: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (28) And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
tr: Walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihī innakum lataʾtūnal-fāḥishah, mā sabaqakum bihā min aḥadim minal-ʿālamīn

ar: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ ٱلْمُنكَرَ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: (29) Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road[1130] and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allāh, if you should be of the truthful."
enNotes: [1130]- i.e., commit highway robbery and acts of aggression against travelers.
tr: Aʾinnakum lataʾtūnar-rijāla wataqṭaʿūnas-sabīla wataʾtūna fī nādīkumul-munkar, famā kāna jawāba qawmihī illā an qāluʾtinā biʿadhābillāhi in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
en: (30) He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."
tr: Qāla rabbinṣurnī ʿalal-qawmil-mufsidīn

ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوٓا۟ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا۟ ظَٰلِمِينَ
en: (31) And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Abraham with the good tidings,[1131] they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that [i.e., Lot's] city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."
enNotes: [1131]- Of the birth of Isaac and his descendant, Jacob.
tr: Walammā jāʾat rusulunā ibrāhīma bil-bushrā qālū innā muhlikū ahli hādhihil-qaryah, inna ahlahā kānū ẓālimīn

ar: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
en: (32) [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind."
tr: Qāla inna fīhā lūṭā, qālū naḥnu aʿlamu biman fīhā, lanunajjiyannahū waʾahlahū illamraʾatahū kānat minal-ghābirīn

ar: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
en: (33) And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort.[1132] They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.
tr: Walammā an jāʾat rusulunā lūṭan sīʾa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿaw waqālū lā takhaf walā taḥzan, innā munajjūka waʾahlaka illamraʾataka kānat minal-ghābirīn

ar: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
en: (34) Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."
tr: Innā munzilūna ʿalā ahli hādhihil-qaryati rijzam minas-samāʾi bimā kānū yafsuqūn

ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
en: (35) And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
tr: Walaqat taraknā minhā āyatam bayyinatal liqawmiy yaʿqilūn

ar: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
en: (36) And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
tr: Waʾilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban faqāla yāqawmiʿbudullāha warjul-yawmal-ākhira walā taʿthaw fil-arḍi mufsidīn

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
en: (37) But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
tr: Fakadhdhabūhu faʾakhadhathumur-rajfatu faʾaṣbaḥū fī dārihim jāthimīn

ar: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
en: (38) And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.
tr: Waʿādaw wathamūda waqat tabayyana lakum mim masākinihim, wazayyana lahumush-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿanis-sabīli wakānū mustabṣirīn

ar: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَٰبِقِينَ
en: (39) And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].
tr: Waqārūna wafirʿawna wahāmān, walaqad jāʾahum mūsā bil-bayyināti fastakbarū fil-arḍi wamā kānū sābiqīn

ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
en: (40) So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allāh would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.
tr: Fakullan akhadhnā bidhambihī faminhum man arsalnā ʿalayhi ḥāṣibā, waminhum man akhadhathuṣ-ṣayḥah, waminhum man khasafnā bihil-arḍ, waminhum man aghraqnā, wamā kānallāhu liyaẓlimahum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn

ar: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ ٱلْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (41) The example of those who take allies other than Allāh is like that of the spider who takes [i.e., constructs] a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.
tr: Mathalul-ladhīnattakhadhū min dūnillāhi awliyāʾa kamathalil-ʿankabūt, ittakhadhat baytā, waʾinna awhanal-buyūti labaytul-ʿankabūt, law kānū yaʿlamūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (42) Indeed, Allāh knows whatever thing they call upon[1133] other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Innallāha yaʿlamu mā yadʿūna min dūnihī min shayʾ, wahuwal-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْعَٰلِمُونَ
en: (43) And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.
tr: Watilkal-amthālu naḍribuhā lin-nās, wamā yaʿqiluhā illal-ʿālimūn

ar: خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (44) Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
tr: Khalaqallāhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqq, inna fī dhālika laʾāyatal lil-muʾminīn

ar: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ
en: (45) Recite, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allāh is greater. And Allāh knows that which you do.
tr: Utlu mā ūḥiya ilayka minal-kitābi waʾaqimiṣ-ṣalāh, innaṣ-ṣalāta tanhā ʿanil-faḥshāʾi wal-munkar, waladhikrullāhi akbar, wallāhu yaʿlamu mā taṣnaʿūn

ar: وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ وَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
en: (46) And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
tr: Walā tujādilū ahlal-kitābi illā bil-latī hiya aḥsan, illal-ladhīna ẓalamū minhum waqūlū āmannā bil-ladhī unzila ilaynā waʾunzila ilaykum waʾilāhunā waʾilāhukum wāḥiduw wanaḥnu lahū muslimūn

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَمِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
en: (47) And thus We have sent down to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān]. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.
tr: Wakadhālika anzalnā ilaykal-kitāb, fal-ladhīna ātaynāhumul-kitāba yuʾminūna bih, wamin hāʾulāʾi may yuʾminu bih, wamā yajḥadu biʾāyātinā illal-kāfirūn

ar: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ إِذًا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
en: (48) And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
tr: Wamā kunta tatlū min qablihī min kitābiw walā takhuṭṭuhū biyamīnika idhal lartābal-mubṭilūn

ar: بَلْ هُوَ ءَايَٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَٰتٌ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
en: (49) Rather, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.
tr: Bal huwa āyātum bayyinātun fī ṣudūril-ladhīna ūtul-ʿilm, wamā yajḥadu biʾāyātinā illaẓ-ẓālimūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْـَٔايَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (50) But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
tr: Waqālū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyātum mir rabbih, qul innamal-āyātu ʿindallāh, waʾinnamā ana nadhīrum mubīn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (51) And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.
tr: Awalam yakfihim annā anzalnā ʿalaykal-kitāba yutlā ʿalayhim, inna fī dhālika laraḥmataw wadhikrā liqawmiy yuʾminūn

ar: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰسِرُونَ
en: (52) Say, "Sufficient is Allāh between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allāh - it is those who are the losers."
tr: Qul kafā billāhi baynī wabaynakum shahīdā, yaʿlamu mā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wal-ladhīna āmanū bil-bāṭili wakafarū billāhi ulāʾika humul-khāsirūn

ar: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَوْلَآ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (53) And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.
tr: Wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhāb, walawlā ajalum musammal lajāʾahumul-ʿadhāb, walayaʾtiyannahum baghtataw wahum lā yashʿurūn

ar: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (54) They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
tr: Yastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhāb, waʾinna jahannama lamuḥīṭatum bil-kāfirīn

ar: يَوْمَ يَغْشَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (55) On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do."
tr: Yawma yaghshāhumul-ʿadhābu min fawqihim wamin taḥti arjulihim wayaqūlu dhūqū mā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
en: (56) O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
tr: Yāʿibādiyal-ladhīna āmanū inna arḍī wāsiʿatun faʾiyyāya faʿbudūn

ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (57) Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
tr: Kullu nafsin dhāʾiqatul-mawt, thumma ilaynā turjaʿūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا نِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ
en: (58) And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanubawwiʾannahum minal-jannati ghurafan tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā, niʿma ajrul-ʿāmilīn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
en: (59) Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.
tr: Al-ladhīna ṣabarū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūn

ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (60) And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allāh provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Wakaʾayyim min dābbatil lā taḥmilu rizqahā, allāhu yarzuquhā waʾiyyākum wahuwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
en: (61) If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Then how are they deluded?
tr: Walaʾin saʾaltahum man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara layaqūlunnallāh, faʾannā yuʾfakūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
en: (62) Allāh extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Allāhu yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yashāʾu min ʿibādihī wayaqdiru lah, innallāha bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm

ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
en: (63) And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Praise to Allāh"; but most of them do not reason.
tr: Walaʾin saʾaltahum man nazzala minas-samāʾi māʾan faʾaḥyā bihil-arḍa mim baʿdi mawtihā layaqūlunnallāhu qulil-ḥamdu lillāh, bal aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūn

ar: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ لَهِىَ ٱلْحَيَوَانُ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (64) And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.
tr: Wamā hādhihil-ḥayātud-dunyā illā lahwuw walaʿib, waʾinnad-dāral-ākhirata lahiyal-ḥayawān, law kānū yaʿlamūn

ar: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (65) And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith and hope]. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him
tr: Faʾidhā rakibū fil-fulki daʿawullāha mukhliṣīna lahud-dīn, falammā najjāhum ilal-barri idhā hum yushrikūn

ar: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (66) So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.[1134]
enNotes: [1134]- Grammatically, the verse may also be read as a threat, i.e., "So let them deny what We have granted them and let them enjoy themselves, for they are going to know."
tr: Liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum waliyatamattaʿū, fasawfa yaʿlamūn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ
en: (67) Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away[1135] all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?
tr: Awalam yaraw annā jaʿalnā ḥaraman āminaw wayutakhaṭṭafun-nāsu min ḥawlihim, afabilbāṭili yuʾminūna wabiniʿmatillāhi yakfurūn

ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (68) And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?
tr: Waman aẓlamu mimmaniftarā ʿalallāhi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bil-ḥaqqi lammā jāʾah, alaysa fī jahannama mathwal lil-kāfirīn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
en: (69) And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.[1136] And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.
enNotes: [1136]- The various ways and means to attain the acceptance and pleasure of Allāh.
tr: Wal-ladhīna jāhadū fīnā lanahdiyannahum subulanā, waʾinnallāha lamaʿal-muḥsinīn
